en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a traditional half‑timbered country inn with two attached buildings. In front of the inn stand several people behind a fence, and to the right a horse‑drawn carriage with a driver is visible on a dirt road. Trees frame the scene. The printed title in German at the top identifies the guesthouse and its locality, and a sign on the facade of the building also bears the guesthouse name.
